summary: Lists copy return values: backup_file (when changed with backup), checksum (SHA1), dest, gid, group, md5sum (when supported), mode, owner, size, src (when changed), state, and uid.
questions: How do I get the name of the backup file copy created?
What does the copy module return?
How do I get the checksum of the copied file?

answer_card.title: copy return values
answer_card.answer_md:
- `backup_file`: backup file name (when changed and `backup=yes`)
- `checksum`: SHA1 after copy; `md5sum`: MD5 when supported
- `dest`: destination path
- `src`: source file used on the target (when changed)
- `owner`, `uid`, `group`, `gid`, `mode`, `size`, `state`: properties of the target after execution
